elements.name: Add product to cart successfully
elements.description:
"""
    Verify that user can add a product to the shopping cart.
    Priority: High | Severity: Major
    """

steps.name: the user is on the home page
the user searches for "laptop"
the user clicks on the first product
the user clicks add to cart button
the user should see success notification "product has been added"
the cart should contain 1 item

name: Shopping Cart
description:
As a customer
  I want to manage items in my cart
  So that I can purchase products I want

steps.name: the user is logged in
the user has a product in the cart

elements.name: Successful checkout with cash on delivery
elements.description:
"""
    Verify that logged-in user can complete checkout using cash on delivery.
    Priority: High | Severity: Critical
    """

steps.name: the user opens the cart page
check the check box of the term of the services
the user proceeds to checkout
the user fills billing address with valid data
the user continues to shipping method choose to stay on default and click continue
the user continues to payment method choose to stay on default and click continue
the user continues to payment info then continue
the user confirms the order
the order should be placed successfully
the user should see order confirmation with order number

name: Checkout Process
description:
As a customer
  I want to complete the checkout process
  So that I can purchase products
